ideas.name: Sleep sounds & white noise
ideas.pitch: Used every night for sleep, focus and babies. BetterSleep has 10M+ Play installs; White Noise is #5 on Apple's US Top Paid Health & Fitness chart.
ideas.fasEdge: Rivals lock sounds and sleep timers behind paywalls and show ads. FAS generates white, pink and brown noise with Web Audio, so it is free and offline.
ideas.caveats: Background audio from a Home Screen PWA is unreliable when the screen locks; suggest Wake Lock. Guided Calm-style content is licensed and out of scope.
ideas.requiresWhy: Noise is generated on the device with Web Audio; syncing favourite mixes is optional.

ideas.name: Voice recorder
ideas.pitch: Lectures, meetings and memos: two Play recorders have 50M+ installs each, and Just Press Record is #9 on Apple's US Top Paid Utilities chart.
ideas.fasEdge: Recordings stay on the device. Transcription and summaries run on the user's own AI key instead of an Otter-style subscription.
ideas.caveats: Recording stops when the screen locks or the tab is backgrounded, especially on iOS. Audio stays local. Recording phone calls is impossible.
ideas.requiresWhy: Records from the microphone; AI transcription and cloud backup are extras.

ideas.name: Financial & trade calculators
ideas.pitch: Professionals, exam takers and trades pay for accurate calculators: they hold about 8 of Apple's US Top Paid Finance top 30, and QuickBend is Paid Productivity #1.
ideas.fasEdge: TVM, NPV/IRR and conduit bending are pure maths that run offline. FAS removes the $6–15 price tag.
ideas.requiresWhy: Pure maths that runs in the browser.

ideas.name: Sound level meter (dB)
ideas.pitch: Noise complaints, workplace checks and curiosity. Two sound meters have 10M+ Play installs each; Decibel X has 163k App Store ratings.
ideas.fasEdge: Sensor tools are a classic adware category. FAS ships the same meter with no ads and no tracking.
ideas.caveats: Readings are uncalibrated estimates, as with native apps: label them approximate and turn off auto gain and noise suppression.
ideas.requiresWhy: Measures loudness from the microphone.

ideas.name: Voice changer
ideas.pitch: Fun, shareable clips: "Voice changer with effects" has 100M+ Play installs and 1.48M reviews.
ideas.caveats: Pitch shifting without changing speed needs a small DSP library. iOS records AAC/MP4, so handle codecs.
ideas.requiresWhy: Records your voice from the microphone and applies effects on the device.

ideas.name: Drum pad & beat maker
ideas.pitch: Music making without gear: Drum Pad Machine has 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Sample packs are the product: kits must be CC0 or self-made and cached for offline use. Licensed packs are not an option.
ideas.requiresWhy: Plays samples with Web Audio; sharing beats with others is optional.

ideas.name: Compass, bubble level & ruler
ideas.pitch: DIY, hiking and hanging pictures: a compass, a bubble level and a ruler app each have 10M+ Play installs.
ideas.fasEdge: Sensor tools are a classic adware category. FAS puts all three in one offline app with no ads.
ideas.caveats: iOS needs an explicit motion permission and uses webkitCompassHeading. Compass accuracy varies; the ruler needs on-screen calibration. No camera AR measuring.
ideas.requiresWhy: Compass and bubble level read the phone's motion and orientation sensors.

ideas.name: Everyday calculators: tip, %, discount, age, EMI
ideas.pitch: Tip, EMI and age calculators each reach millions of Play installs; people want every everyday calculator in one place.
ideas.fasEdge: Ad-funded calculator apps run full-screen interstitials and over-ask for permissions. FAS puts them all in one clean, offline app.
ideas.requiresWhy: Pure maths that runs in the browser.

ideas.name: Baby tracker (two parents, live)
ideas.pitch: Parents log feeds, naps and diapers around the clock. Baby Tracker – Newborn Log has a 4.9 rating; Huckleberry peaked near $69K a week in US revenue (Sensor Tower).
ideas.fasEdge: Sleep predictions and partner sync are often paid, and child health data sits with VC-backed firms. FAS syncs two parents live, free and private.
ideas.requiresWhy: Two parents sign in to one shared log that updates live; feed reminders are optional.
ideas.pasEdge: Both parents see every feed and nap live in one private log, with no premium tier for the second caregiver.

ideas.name: Sobriety / quit counter
ideas.pitch: Recovery is counted in days: I Am Sober claims 18M+ users and charges $4.99/month or $49.99/year.
ideas.fasEdge: Stats and motivation packs are locked, and the data is very sensitive. A private counter with nothing to unlock.
ideas.requiresWhy: A day count works from a date stored on the device; sync and milestones are extras.

ideas.name: Reading log & book tracker
ideas.pitch: Readers track shelves, progress and yearly goals. Goodreads is the default tracker, and StoryGraph sells a Plus tier.
ideas.fasEdge: Track reading without Amazon: Goodreads is Amazon-owned with ads, and StoryGraph paywalls stats. Open Library search, shelves and goals, free.
ideas.requiresWhy: Searches a public book database such as Open Library; sharing shelves is optional.

ideas.name: Teleprompter
ideas.pitch: Creators read scripts on camera: PromptSmart Pro is #5 on Apple's US Top Paid Photo & Video chart at $29.99.
ideas.fasEdge: Scrolling text with mirror mode, free instead of $29.99.
ideas.requiresWhy: Scrolls text on screen; voice-following scroll would need the microphone.

ideas.name: Wishlist & gift registry
ideas.pitch: Holidays, birthdays and weddings: GoWish is #3 on Apple's US Top Free Lifestyle chart.
ideas.caveats: Product previews are scraped through the proxy (CORS) and count toward its 10k requests a day.
ideas.requiresWhy: Others must open your list and mark gifts as reserved; product link previews are extras.

ideas.name: Event invite & RSVP page
ideas.pitch: Partiful replaced Evite for younger users: it is #4 on Apple's US Top Free Lifestyle chart with 269k ratings.
ideas.fasEdge: Web-first suits it: guests open a link and never install anything.
ideas.caveats: Overlaps the catalog's Meetup app; check before building.
ideas.requiresWhy: Guests open one invite page and their RSVPs are saved where the host can see them.

ideas.name: Test-prep quiz banks (driving, ham radio)
ideas.pitch: A high-intent, time-boxed need, so people pay: Stack the States and HamStudy are #5 and #6 on Apple's US Top Paid Education chart.
ideas.caveats: The value is the question bank: use public-domain sources such as state driver manuals and the FCC question pools.
ideas.requiresWhy: Question banks ship with the app and run offline.

ideas.name: Digital business card (QR / vCard)
ideas.pitch: Networking without paper cards: Blinq is #17 on Apple's US Top Grossing Business chart, with 132k ratings.
ideas.fasEdge: Blinq and Popl are subscription-monetised. FAS makes the vCard, QR code and public profile page free.
ideas.caveats: No NFC writing on iOS Safari, so it is QR only.
ideas.requiresWhy: Your card is a public profile page other people open from a link or QR code.

ideas.name: GPS timestamp camera
ideas.pitch: Field workers, contractors and inspectors prove where and when a photo was taken: GPS Map Camera has 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Photos save by download or share, not straight to the gallery. Map thumbnails must respect the OSM tile policy; writing EXIF needs a small library.
ideas.requiresWhy: Takes photos with the camera and stamps them with your GPS position.

ideas.name: Flashlight & screen light
ideas.pitch: Huge historic demand: Tiny Flashlight and "Flashlight" have 100M+ Play installs each.
ideas.fasEdge: Flashlights are the classic home of over-permissioned adware. A FAS version asks for nothing it doesn't need.
ideas.caveats: LED control works on Android Chrome only; iOS gets a white screen light. Phones have a built-in toggle anyway. Low priority.
ideas.requiresWhy: Turning on the LED uses the camera's torch control (Android browsers only).

ideas.name: Tally, tasbeeh & score counters
ideas.pitch: Prayer counting, board games, inventory and events: Digital Tasbeeh Counter and Chess Clock have 10M+ Play installs each.
ideas.fasEdge: Rivals put ads in a tap counter. FAS adds what native apps lack: a shared live scoreboard.
ideas.caveats: The Vibration API is missing on iOS Safari. The catalog's Chess Clock covers one piece of the set.
ideas.requiresWhy: A tap counter works on the device; a live shared scoreboard is optional.

ideas.name: GPS speedometer & trip meter
ideas.pitch: Drivers, cyclists and runners: GPS Speedometer has 10M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Foreground only, so the screen must stay on. No background trip logging.
ideas.requiresWhy: Speed and distance come from GPS while the app is open.

ideas.name: Magnifier & mirror
ideas.pitch: Older users reading small print, and make-up: a magnifier and a mirror app have 10M+ Play installs each.
ideas.caveats: Optical zoom and torch control work on Android Chrome only; iOS gets digital zoom.
ideas.requiresWhy: Shows the camera feed zoomed in or as a mirror.

ideas.name: Car fuel & expense log
ideas.pitch: Drivers track fuel economy and running costs: Fuelio and Drivvo have 5M+ Play installs each.
ideas.requiresWhy: A log and charts that work with data kept on the device.

ideas.name: AI task breakdown / ADHD helper
ideas.pitch: An ADHD-friendly "break this into steps" tool that is simple and beloved: Goblin Tools is #2 on Apple's US Top Paid Productivity chart.
ideas.caveats: The user must bring a key, which is friction for non-technical users.
ideas.requiresWhy: Breaking a task into steps needs an AI model.

ideas.name: Translator (text and voice)
ideas.pitch: Travel and immigration: Google Translate has 1B+ Play installs, and iTranslate is a large subscription business with 531k App Store ratings.
ideas.fasEdge: Translation through the user's own AI key instead of another subscription.
ideas.caveats: There is no free no-key translation API, so it is BYO key only. Safari speech recognition is partial; camera and offline translation are out.
ideas.requiresWhy: Translation needs an AI model or a translation API with the owner's key.

ideas.name: AI photo calorie logger
ideas.pitch: Snap a meal instead of logging it: Cal AI reportedly made about $35M in 2025 and is #12 on Apple's US Top Grossing Health & Fitness chart.
ideas.fasEdge: $30–60/yr for what is one vision-model call. With the user's own key the photo goes straight to their model and is never stored.
ideas.caveats: Needs the user's own AI key. Pairs with the calorie log upgrade.
ideas.requiresWhy: Photographs a meal and asks a vision AI model to estimate calories.

ideas.name: AI journaling & reflection coach
ideas.pitch: Guided prompts and summaries for journaling: Rosebud raised a $6M seed in 2025, and Day One has 119k App Store ratings.
ideas.fasEdge: $10–15/month subscriptions are mostly LLM markup, and intimate entries sit on a vendor server. FAS uses the user's own AI key and keeps entries local.
ideas.caveats: The user must bring an OpenAI or Anthropic key, which is friction for non-technical users.
ideas.requiresWhy: Reflection prompts and summaries need an AI model.

ideas.name: Text-to-speech reader
ideas.pitch: Accessibility, dyslexia and "listen instead of read": Speechify is #15 on Apple's US Top Grossing Productivity chart.
ideas.fasEdge: Free system voices through speechSynthesis; premium voices only with the user's own key.
ideas.caveats: The pdf.js worker is large, so it must be a separate chunk. Fetching article URLs needs the proxy because of CORS.
ideas.requiresWhy: Reads text aloud with the browser's built-in voices; premium voices and URL import are extras.

ideas.name: Stylish text / fancy fonts generator
ideas.pitch: People decorate bios and posts with Unicode styles: Stylish Text has 10M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: A copy-paste Unicode generator is feasible; the keyboard part is not.
ideas.requiresWhy: Converts text to Unicode styles in the browser.

ideas.name: Christian prayer & devotion
ideas.pitch: Rosary, Liturgy of the Hours and daily readings: Hallow earned about $10M a month at its peak, with Lent spikes.
ideas.fasEdge: Hallow charges $69.99/yr for devotional content, much of it public domain. FAS uses public-domain texts, free.
ideas.caveats: Content licensing: use only public-domain texts.
ideas.requiresWhy: Prayers and readings are public-domain texts shipped with the app.

ideas.name: Period & cycle tracker
ideas.pitch: A daily need with very high engagement: Flo and Period Calendar each have 100M+ Play installs, and Flo is #2 on Apple's US Top Free Health & Fitness chart.
ideas.fasEdge: Flo settled with the US FTC over sharing health data. Local-first storage, no analytics SDKs and free predictions make "your data never leaves your phone" the pitch.
ideas.caveats: Keep predictions simple and honest (average cycle length). Keep push text generic on the lock screen. Never claim contraceptive accuracy.
ideas.requiresWhy: Cycle log and predictions work on the device; period-due reminders are optional.

ideas.name: Medication & blood-pressure log
ideas.pitch: Chronic conditions, carers and doctor visits: Medisafe and MyTherapy have 5M+ Play installs, and Pocket Blood Pressure is #4 on Apple's US Top Free Health & Fitness chart.
ideas.fasEdge: A med schedule, vitals charts and a PDF report for the doctor, with health data encrypted on the device and no paid tier.
ideas.caveats: A missed push must never be the only safeguard: show doses due on open. Keep lock-screen text generic. Don't copy camera heart-rate apps; they are medically dubious.
ideas.requiresWhy: Dose reminders are the core of a medication app, so it needs push notifications.

ideas.name: Prayer times & Qibla compass
ideas.pitch: Used daily by a very large audience: Muslim Pro has 100M+ Play installs (145M+ downloads, company-reported) and Athan 10M+.
ideas.fasEdge: Muslim Pro and several Qibla apps shared location data that reached US military contractors. FAS calculates prayer times on the device and never sells location.
ideas.caveats: Alerts are Web Push at the computed times; a full adhan playing through a locked phone is alarm behaviour and won't happen. Recitation audio is licensed content.
ideas.requiresWhy: Times are computed on the device; the Qibla compass needs the orientation sensor.

ideas.name: Intermittent fasting timer
ideas.pitch: A timer plus a log riding a strong diet trend. Google Play's top fasting app has 50M+ installs and Zero has 445k App Store ratings.
ideas.fasEdge: Zero, Fastic and Simple charge $40–100/yr for a clock, and Fastic faced German consumer-centre action over unwanted renewals. A fasting timer should be free.
ideas.caveats: The timer is computed from a stored start time, so nothing runs in the background. "Fast complete" and eating-window alerts go out as Web Push at the end time.
ideas.requiresWhy: The timer runs from a saved start time; end-of-fast alerts are optional.

ideas.name: Water intake tracker & reminders
ideas.pitch: Hydration goals, with an app literally named for its reminders: Water Reminder has 10M+ Play installs and a 4.8 rating.
ideas.fasEdge: Incumbents paywall reminder customisation and show ads. FAS gives the reminder schedule, with quiet hours, away free.
ideas.caveats: The reminder is the product, so ship fas.push soon after launch. Respect quiet hours.
ideas.requiresWhy: The reminder is the product: it needs scheduled push notifications.

ideas.name: Document scanner to PDF
ideas.pitch: Receipts, forms and homework as PDFs. One of the most subscription-monetised utility types: six or more scanners sit in Apple's US Top Grossing Business top 50.
ideas.fasEdge: Rivals use weekly-subscription traps, watermarks and forced cloud upload; CamScanner shipped a malicious ad SDK in 2019. FAS scans on the device: no upload, no watermark.
ideas.caveats: OCR is the hard part: tesseract.js data is many MB and must be a lazy-loaded asset, which the P2 compliance rule now allows. Scans stay on the device; there is no file storage.
ideas.requiresWhy: Captures pages with the camera and builds the PDF on the device; OCR is an extra.

ideas.name: Habit tracker & streaks
ideas.pitch: Self-improvement streaks: Streaks is #1 on Apple's US Top Paid Health & Fitness chart, and open-source Loop reached 5M+ Play installs with no marketing.
ideas.fasEdge: Rivals paywall after 3–5 habits and nag for upgrades. FAS offers unlimited habits, Loop-style scoring and accountability with friends, free.
ideas.caveats: Loop is already free and open source, so the FAS edge is the web, multi-device sync and friends. No Home Screen widgets.
ideas.requiresWhy: Habits and streaks work with data on the device; reminders and friends are extras.

ideas.name: To-do list with due dates & shared lists
ideas.pitch: Productivity basics: Google Tasks, Microsoft To Do and TickTick have 10M+ Play installs each, and Things 3 is #3 on Apple's US Top Paid Productivity chart.
ideas.fasEdge: People pay once for a polished, private task app. FAS offers that free, with cross-device sync and shared lists.
ideas.caveats: The catalog already has several to-do apps; the plan is one flagship, not another duplicate.
ideas.requiresWhy: Shared lists need sign-in and data other people can read and edit.
ideas.pasEdge: Shared lists stay private to the people invited, with roles, instead of a free tier capped at a few collaborators.

ideas.name: Unit & currency converter
ideas.pitch: Travel, shopping, cooking and DIY: several currency and unit converters have 10M+ Play installs each.
ideas.fasEdge: Many converters are ad-funded, paywall currency rates or lack an offline mode. FAS: every unit, live currencies, offline.
ideas.caveats: Rates are daily, not real-time: label them clearly and keep last-known rates for offline use.
ideas.requiresWhy: Currency rates come from a public exchange-rate API.

ideas.name: Photo editor, collage & print layouts
ideas.pitch: Social posting and prints: Picsart has 1B+ Play installs and Collage Maker 100M+; Print to Size is #6 on Apple's US Top Paid Photo & Video chart.
ideas.caveats: No server-side AI such as background removal; only via the user's key or a lazy on-device model. Export via download or the share sheet.
ideas.requiresWhy: Opens photos from your device and edits them in the browser.

ideas.name: Recipe manager & meal planner
ideas.pitch: Saved recipes plus weekly planning: Paprika is #1 on Apple's US Top Paid Food & Drink chart, and ReciMe #1 on Top Grossing Food & Drink.
ideas.fasEdge: A crowded field of paid and subscription apps. FAS imports recipes by URL and shares a live grocery list, free.
ideas.caveats: Recipe photos can't be uploaded (no file storage); link to the source image. URL import parses JSON-LD through the proxy.
ideas.requiresWhy: Recipes and plans can live on the device; URL import, sync and shared lists are extras.

ideas.name: Calorie & macro food log
ideas.pitch: Weight loss is a perennial goal: MyFitnessPal has 100M+ Play installs and is #1 on Apple's US Top Grossing Health & Fitness chart.
ideas.fasEdge: MyFitnessPal paywalls barcode scan and macros. FAS logs food free, with barcode lookup through Open Food Facts.
ideas.waitsOn: Open Food Facts on the API list (barcode lookup)
ideas.caveats: The food database is the moat, and Open Food Facts coverage varies by country. Safari has no BarcodeDetector, so use a JS decoder.
ideas.requiresWhy: Food lookup needs a public food database such as Open Food Facts.

ideas.name: Interval / HIIT / Tabata timer
ideas.pitch: Every gym-goer and CrossFitter needs one: Seconds Pro is #8 on Apple's US Top Paid Health & Fitness chart at $7.99.
ideas.fasEdge: Saved routines and voice cues are paywalled elsewhere. FAS builds any interval routine with voice cues, free.
ideas.caveats: Cues stop when the screen locks, and iOS Safari has no haptics.
ideas.requiresWhy: Timer and voice cues run in the browser.

ideas.name: Flashcards with spaced repetition
ideas.pitch: Students, language learners and medical students: AnkiMobile is #1 on Apple's US Top Paid Education chart at $24.99, so people pay for SRS.
ideas.fasEdge: Quizlet moved Learn mode behind its paywall in 2022 and shows ads. FAS: FSRS scheduling, Anki import and shared public decks, free.
ideas.caveats: The 1 MB KV limit restricts very large personal decks, so keep the bulk in IndexedDB. Shared decks must be split into 64 KB docs.
ideas.requiresWhy: Spaced repetition runs on the device; shared public decks are optional.

ideas.name: Weather without location resale
ideas.pitch: Checked daily: The Weather Channel and AccuWeather have 100M+ Play installs each.
ideas.fasEdge: Big incumbents are ad-heavy and monetise location; The Weather Channel settled a suit over it. FAS: Open-Meteo forecasts, no account, no resale.
ideas.caveats: No home-screen widget. Severe-weather alerts need a scheduled forecast check. A radar overlay needs a tile source outside the listed APIs.
ideas.requiresWhy: Forecasts come from a public weather API; severe-weather alerts need a scheduled check.

ideas.name: Instrument tuner & metronome
ideas.pitch: Every musician needs one: GuitarTuna has 100M+ Play installs, and TonalEnergy is #1 on Apple's US Top Paid Music chart.
ideas.fasEdge: GuitarTuna went subscription and locks alternate tunings; metronome extras like tempo ramps are paywalled. FAS: every tuning and feature free.
ideas.caveats: Turn off echo cancellation, noise suppression and auto gain. Metronome timing must use the AudioContext clock; background playback is unreliable on iOS.
ideas.requiresWhy: The tuner listens to your instrument through the microphone.

ideas.name: PDF reader & tools (merge, split, sign)
ideas.pitch: Everyone gets PDFs: Acrobat Reader has 500M+ Play installs, and five PDF readers sit in AppBrain's US Tools top 10.
ideas.fasEdge: Most top-chart PDF apps are thin wrappers full of ads, and PDF readers feature in Avast's fleeceware list. FAS works on local files with no ads.
ideas.caveats: The pdf.js worker is large, so it must load as a separate lazy chunk. Local files only.
ideas.requiresWhy: Opens and edits PDF files from your device in the browser.

ideas.name: Home bodyweight workouts
ideas.pitch: Free, guided, no gym: Leap Fitness has several 100M+ Play titles built from one template.
ideas.caveats: The value is partly content: exercise art must be original or openly licensed. Keep animations as SVG/CSS so the app stays small and offline.
ideas.requiresWhy: Workout plans and cues ship with the app.

ideas.name: Couch-to-5K run coach
ideas.pitch: A structured beginner programme with high completion pride: Couch to 5K and Watch to 5K are #11 and #12 on Apple's US Top Paid Health & Fitness chart.
ideas.fasEdge: The same run-walk plan with voice cues, free instead of $4.99.
ideas.caveats: No background GPS and no cues once the screen locks: keep the screen on (Wake Lock) or use time-only intervals.
ideas.requiresWhy: A timed run-walk plan with voice cues; GPS distance is optional.

ideas.name: QR & barcode scanner and generator
ideas.pitch: Payments, menus, Wi-Fi and tickets: Gamma Play's scanner has 500M+ installs, and four QR readers are in Apple's US Top Grossing Utilities top 50.
ideas.fasEdge: QR apps are classic fleeceware: weekly trials, surprise charges and fake ad buttons for a feature built into the iPhone camera. FAS: free forever, no trial.
ideas.caveats: BarcodeDetector exists only on Android Chrome; iOS needs a lazy-loaded JS/WASM decoder. The plan merges the two catalog apps into one.

leaders.name: QR code reader & QR code Scanner

ideas.requiresWhy: Scans codes with the camera.

ideas.name: Subscription tracker
ideas.pitch: "Stop paying for things I forgot." Subpilot and SubSeek are #27 and #30 on Apple's US Top Grossing Finance chart.
ideas.fasEdge: A paid app to track paid apps. FAS keeps the list, monthly total and renewal reminders free.
ideas.caveats: Automatic detection would need bank data, so entry is manual.
ideas.requiresWhy: Renewal alerts are the point: scheduled push, or email sent on a schedule.

ideas.name: Days-since & event countdown
ideas.pitch: Emotional, shareable and simple: My Love has 1.04M App Store ratings, and Time Until has 5M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: These apps live on Home Screen widgets, which a web app can't offer. Milestone days can be pushed instead.
ideas.requiresWhy: Date maths on the device; milestone pushes are optional.

ideas.name: Shared grocery list
ideas.pitch: Households shop together: Listonic has 10M+ Play installs, and AnyList a 4.9 rating.
ideas.caveats: Needs offline edit merging.
ideas.requiresWhy: A household shares one list, so it needs sign-in and shared data.
ideas.pasEdge: One private household list that syncs between everyone in it, without the ads and upsells of the leaders.

ideas.name: Gym workout log
ideas.pitch: Lifters log sets every session: Hevy has 5M+ Play installs and 98k App Store ratings, showing that a social feed adds pull.
ideas.caveats: A rest timer ending in the background arrives as a notification; iOS Safari has no Vibration API.
ideas.requiresWhy: Sets and progress charts work with data on the device; a social feed is optional.

ideas.name: Mood tracker & private journal
ideas.pitch: Mental-health self-tracking and private journaling: Daylio and Diary with Lock have 10M+ Play installs each.
ideas.fasEdge: Stats and exports are paywalled, and this is sensitive mental-health data. FAS adds a passphrase lock with client-side encryption, free.
ideas.caveats: "Lock" means a passphrase plus client-side encryption, not OS biometrics. No photo attachments on the server.
ideas.requiresWhy: Entries and mood charts can stay encrypted on the device.

ideas.name: Calculator with history
ideas.pitch: Used daily by everyone. OEM calculators are bare-bones, so third-party ones with history and percent tools reach 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.fasEdge: A very crowded field: win on no ads, history and dark mode.
ideas.caveats: Big install numbers are inflated by preinstalled OEM calculators.
ideas.requiresWhy: Pure maths that runs in the browser.

ideas.name: Notes & checklists
ideas.pitch: A universal need: ColorNote shows a simple coloured-note app can reach 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: KV caps at 1 MB and 100 keys per user: shard notes or keep the full archive in IndexedDB. No image attachments.
ideas.requiresWhy: Notes work on the device; sync across devices is optional.

ideas.name: Stopwatch, timer & world clock
ideas.pitch: Cooking, workouts, interval timing and time zones: two independent stopwatch apps have 10M+ Play installs each.
ideas.caveats: A finished timer can notify, but alarm-clock behaviour (ringing through a locked phone or silent mode) is not feasible.
ideas.requiresWhy: Stopwatch, timer and world clock run in the browser.

ideas.name: Budget & expense tracker (manual)
ideas.pitch: Personal finance without bank linking: Money Manager and Wallet have 10M+ Play installs, and YNAB is #4 on Apple's US Top Grossing Finance chart.
ideas.fasEdge: Mint shut down in 2024, YNAB-style apps cost about $100/yr, and bank-sync apps harvest financial data. FAS: envelope budgeting, no bank access, no fee.
ideas.caveats: No bank sync. Long histories approach the 1 MB KV cap, so roll up by month.
ideas.requiresWhy: Manual budgeting works with data on the device.

ideas.name: Invoice & estimate maker
ideas.pitch: Every tradesperson and freelancer needs one: seven or more invoice apps are in Apple's US Top Grossing Business or Finance top 50.
ideas.fasEdge: Rivals charge $10–20/month for clients, line items and a PDF. Every primitive exists in FAS, so it can be free.
ideas.caveats: No online card payments; include a payment-link or bank-details field instead.
ideas.requiresWhy: Builds the PDF in the browser; emailing and online payment are extras.

ideas.name: Sun, moon & night-sky planner
ideas.pitch: Photographers plan golden hour and families point at stars: SkyView is #2 on Apple's US Top Paid Education chart, PhotoPills #3 in Paid Photo & Video.
ideas.caveats: DeviceOrientation needs an explicit permission prompt on iOS, and AR overlay quality is lower than native.
ideas.requiresWhy: Sun and moon positions are computed on the device for a chosen place.

ideas.name: Virtual piano
ideas.pitch: Kids, beginners and playing for fun: Perfect Piano has 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Audio latency on some Android devices. Samples must be CC0 or your own; ship a synth fallback to stay small.
ideas.requiresWhy: Plays notes with Web Audio.

ideas.name: Drawing & sketch pad
ideas.pitch: Doodling, kids and digital art: ibis Paint X and Sketchbook have 100M+ Play installs each.
ideas.caveats: No cloud gallery (no file storage). Small drawings could be stored as vector strokes within the 64 KB doc limit. Layers and brushes are medium effort.
ideas.requiresWhy: Draws on a canvas in the browser; a cloud gallery is optional.

ideas.name: Scientific & graphing calculator
ideas.pitch: Students and exam-style calculators: Scientific calculator plus 991 has 50M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Desmos is already free and ad-free, so the FAS edge is smaller. Import only the parts of math.js you need.
ideas.requiresWhy: Pure maths that runs in the browser.

ideas.name: Resume / CV maker
ideas.pitch: Job seekers, especially in emerging markets: Resume – Intelligent CV maker has 50M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Template quality decides success. Keep jsPDF fonts small, and store one or two resumes per user within KV limits.
ideas.requiresWhy: Builds the CV PDF in the browser.

ideas.name: Dictionary & word of the day
ideas.pitch: Students, ESL learners and word nerds: Merriam-Webster has 50M+ Play installs.
ideas.fasEdge: Incumbents rate poorly because of ads and streak-shaming paywalls. FAS: free lookups, saved words and spaced review.
ideas.caveats: Lookups need a connection; offline covers cached or saved words only. Word of the day needs a curated local list.
ideas.requiresWhy: Definitions come from a public dictionary API.

ideas.name: Group bill splitting
ideas.pitch: Trips and flatmates: Splitwise and tricount have 10M+ Play installs each.
ideas.fasEdge: Splitwise caps free users at 3–4 expenses a day with video ads, and users pushed back. FAS: no daily limit, shared groups, multi-currency.
ideas.caveats: No payments: "settle up" is a record only. Needs conflict handling for concurrent edits.
ideas.requiresWhy: Group members sign in and share one ledger of expenses.
ideas.pasEdge: Group balances stay private to the group, and nothing like Splitwise’s daily expense cap on the free tier.

ideas.name: Spin the wheel & randomizers
ideas.pitch: Classrooms, groups and streamers: Spin The Wheel – Random Picker has 10M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: A commodity: the social room where everyone sees the same spin is the hook.
ideas.requiresWhy: Spins run on the device; a shared room where everyone sees the spin is optional.

ideas.name: Focus / Pomodoro timer
ideas.pitch: Studying and work: Focus To-Do has 10M+ Play installs, and Forest's grow-a-tree mechanic peaked near $400K a month on iOS.
ideas.fasEdge: Forest is paid upfront on iOS and needs Pro for cross-device. FAS adds free group focus rooms.
ideas.caveats: It cannot block other apps; that needs native Screen Time APIs.
ideas.requiresWhy: The timer runs in the browser; group focus rooms are optional.

ideas.name: Periodic table
ideas.pitch: Students and chemistry fans: Periodic Table 2026 has 10M+ Play installs and a 4.8 rating.
ideas.requiresWhy: Static element data shipped with the app.

ideas.name: Daily quotes & affirmations
ideas.pitch: A low-effort daily ritual: Motivation and I am have 1.07M and 735k App Store ratings and sit in Apple's US Top Grossing Health & Fitness top 30.
ideas.fasEdge: Heavily subscription-monetised for a list of quotes. FAS uses public-domain quotes and a free daily Web Push.
ideas.caveats: These apps live mostly on widgets, which FAS can't offer.
ideas.requiresWhy: Quotes ship with the app; a daily push is optional (widgets are not possible).

ideas.name: 2FA authenticator (TOTP)
ideas.pitch: Mandatory for work and banking accounts: Google Authenticator is #3 on Apple's US Top Free Utilities chart with 1.2M ratings.
ideas.fasEdge: Clones charge subscriptions for an RFC 6238 one-liner; two sit at #12 and #46 in Apple's US Top Grossing Utilities.
ideas.waitsOn: a security review and forced encrypted backup
ideas.caveats: If iOS clears the web app's storage, the user loses their 2FA codes. Needs a mandatory encrypted backup and a review before shipping.
ideas.requiresWhy: Codes are computed on the device, but losing them is unacceptable, so an off-device encrypted backup is needed.

ideas.name: Package tracking
ideas.pitch: Online shoppers follow several parcels at once: pkge is #10 on Apple's US Top Grossing Business chart.
ideas.waitsOn: P4 scheduled server-side fetch and carrier API keys
ideas.caveats: Status on open works today; a push when the status changes needs a scheduled check against the carrier.
ideas.requiresWhy: Carrier APIs need keys kept server-side, and status-change alerts need a scheduled check.

ideas.name: Self-care pet (Finch-style)
ideas.pitch: Gentle habit-building through a virtual pet, with very high retention: Finch has 764k ratings at 4.95 and is #13 on Apple's US Top Grossing Health & Fitness chart.
ideas.waitsOn: character art and writing (not a platform update)
ideas.caveats: The value is character art and writing quality, not code.
ideas.requiresWhy: Runs on the device; what holds it back is character art and writing, not the platform.

ideas.name: Sleep tracking
ideas.pitch: Sleep insights every morning: Sleep Cycle has 10M+ Play installs, and AutoSleep and HeartWatch are #2 and #3 on Apple's US Top Paid Health & Fitness chart.
ideas.caveats: Needs all-night mic and motion sensing in the background, HealthKit or Apple Watch data.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs all-night background microphone and motion sensing, or health-data access.

ideas.name: Phone storage & photo cleaner
ideas.pitch: Full phones and a satisfying swipe UX: Cleanup is #1 on Apple's US Top Grossing Utilities chart, and CCleaner has 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.waitsOn: needs device storage and Photos library access
ideas.caveats: A browser can't enumerate or delete from the Photos library or see device storage. On Android much of the "boost" value is illusory anyway.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs access to the phone's storage and photo library.

ideas.name: VPN & proxy client
ideas.pitch: Privacy and region access: Turbo VPN has 500M+ Play installs, and Shadowrocket is #1 on Apple's US Top Paid Utilities chart.
ideas.caveats: Needs the native VPN / NetworkExtension API and server infrastructure.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs the phone's VPN service plus VPN servers.

ideas.name: Launchers & keyboards
ideas.pitch: Personalising the phone: Gboard has 10B+ Play installs and SwiftKey 1B+; Nova Launcher 100M+.
ideas.waitsOn: needs a system launcher or input method
ideas.caveats: Needs launcher replacement, widgets or wallpaper APIs, or a system input method.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs to replace the phone's launcher or system keyboard.

ideas.name: Caller ID, call blocking & recording
ideas.pitch: Stopping spam calls: Truecaller has 1B+ Play installs, and call-blocking and second-number apps fill Apple's Top Grossing Utilities.
ideas.caveats: Needs system telephony hooks, CallKit or call-directory extensions, paid number provisioning and a crowd-sourced number database.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs phone-call hooks plus a shared spam-number database.

ideas.name: Universal TV remote
ideas.pitch: Lost remotes: TV Remote – Universal Control is #3 on Apple's US Top Grossing Utilities chart with 623k ratings.
ideas.waitsOn: needs an IR blaster or local-network discovery
ideas.caveats: Needs an IR blaster or local-network discovery (SSDP/mDNS), raw sockets and AirPlay/DIAL, which browsers lack.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs an IR blaster or local-network discovery that browsers don't allow.

ideas.name: Plant & rock identifier
ideas.pitch: Point the camera and learn what it is: PictureThis has 1.12M ratings and is #3 on Apple's US Top Grossing Education chart.
ideas.waitsOn: needs a proprietary model and database
ideas.caveats: Identification is a proprietary model plus a curated database. Only feasible as BYO-key LLM vision, at lower accuracy.
ideas.requiresWhy: Identifying a plant from a photo needs a vision AI model.

ideas.name: Bank-linked budgeting & credit
ideas.pitch: Automatic money tracking: Rocket Money is #3 on Apple's US Top Grossing Finance chart with 399k ratings.
ideas.waitsOn: needs bank aggregators and server compute
ideas.caveats: Needs Plaid-style aggregators, server compute and credit-bureau data. The manual budget tracker is buildable.
ideas.requiresWhy: Bank links need a secret aggregator key, server-held tokens and scheduled syncs.

ideas.name: Automatic mileage logging
ideas.pitch: Tax-deductible driving: MileIQ is #1 on Apple's US Top Grossing Finance chart.
ideas.caveats: Automatic trip detection needs background location. A manual trip log with OSRM distance is buildable but misses the point.
ideas.requiresWhy: Automatic trip detection needs location in the background.

ideas.name: Step counter & walking rewards
ideas.pitch: Daily step goals and walking rewards: Step Counter – Pedometer and Sweatcoin have 100M+ Play installs each.
ideas.caveats: Motion events only arrive while the page is open, and HealthKit is off-limits. A foreground "walk session" tracker with friend challenges is the weak substitute.
ideas.requiresWhy: Counting steps all day needs background motion sensing or health data.

ideas.name: Run & ride GPS tracking
ideas.pitch: Runners and cyclists log routes: Strava has 100M+ Play installs and adidas Running 50M+.
ideas.caveats: Needs location while the screen is off. A foreground-only tracker is possible but frustrating.
ideas.requiresWhy: Recording a route needs location while the screen is off.

ideas.name: Antivirus & security suite
ideas.pitch: Fear of malware and identity theft: AVG, Avast One and Norton each have 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Needs OS-level scanning, native device APIs and data-broker or credit-bureau feeds. Often mostly a VPN bundle.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs OS-level scanning of apps and files.

ideas.name: App locker & screen-time blocker
ideas.pitch: Hiding apps and curbing screen time: AppLock and HideU Calculator Lock have 100M+ Play installs; Opal has 90k App Store ratings.
ideas.waitsOn: needs OS accessibility or Screen Time hooks
ideas.caveats: Needs accessibility or usage-access hooks on Android and the Screen Time API on iOS. FAS can only offer a focus timer.
ideas.requiresWhy: Locking or blocking other apps needs OS accessibility or Screen Time hooks.

ideas.name: Screen recorder
ideas.pitch: Tutorials and gameplay clips: Screen Recorder and Mobizen have 100M+ Play installs each.
ideas.caveats: getDisplayMedia is not available in mobile browsers.
ideas.requiresWhy: Recording the phone screen needs the OS; browsers only capture on desktop.

ideas.name: Wi-Fi, file recovery & device info tools
ideas.pitch: Network and phone diagnostics: WiFi Master and DiskDigger have 100M+ Play installs each.
ideas.waitsOn: needs radio, raw storage or system APIs
ideas.caveats: Needs radio, raw storage or system APIs that browsers don't expose.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs radio, raw storage or system APIs that browsers don't expose.

ideas.name: Internet speed test
ideas.pitch: Checking the connection: Speedtest by Ookla has 100M+ Play installs and 1.49M reviews.
ideas.caveats: Needs dedicated measurement servers, which are not in FAS's free-API set, and FAS has no server compute.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs measurement servers to download from and upload to.

ideas.name: Music recognition
ideas.pitch: Naming the song that's playing: Shazam has 500M+ Play installs.
ideas.waitsOn: needs a fingerprint database and server matching
ideas.caveats: Needs an audio fingerprint database and server-side matching.
ideas.requiresWhy: Listens through the microphone and matches against a fingerprint database server-side.

ideas.name: Content-library apps (courses, meditation, scripture)
ideas.pitch: Huge audiences for curated content: Duolingo has 500M+ Play installs, YouVersion Bible 100M+ and Calm 50M+.
ideas.caveats: The value is licensed or curated content, a curriculum or a network effect, not code.
ideas.requiresWhy: Runs on any platform; what holds it back is a licensed content library, not the platform.

ideas.name: Auto clicker & assistive touch
ideas.pitch: Automating taps and on-screen shortcuts: Auto Clicker and Assistive Touch have 100M+ Play installs each.
ideas.caveats: Needs accessibility services that a web app can't use.
ideas.requiresWhy: Automated taps need Android accessibility services.

ideas.name: Sticker maker, status saver & video downloader
ideas.pitch: WhatsApp extras: a sticker maker, a status saver and a video downloader each have 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.waitsOn: needs native intents and other apps' storage
ideas.caveats: Needs native intents to WhatsApp or access to other apps' storage. Downloaders also raise ToS and copyright issues.
ideas.requiresWhy: Needs to hand files to WhatsApp and read other apps' storage.

ideas.name: Alarm clock
ideas.pitch: Waking up reliably: Alarmy has 249k App Store ratings and is #26 on Apple's US Top Grossing Lifestyle chart.
ideas.waitsOn: needs to ring through a locked phone
ideas.caveats: A Web Push notification can't ring loudly through a locked phone, override silent mode or guarantee an exact-second wake. Unreliable alarms are worse than none.
ideas.requiresWhy: An alarm must ring through a locked phone and silent mode.

ideas.name: Buy & sell secondhand marketplace
ideas.pitch: Selling clothes and household items second-hand: Vinted is #2 on Apple's US Top Free chart and has 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Needs moderation and buyer/seller trust. Local pickup works without payments; shipped orders need checkout and payouts to sellers, which PAS does not offer.
ideas.pasEdge: Listings with photos and private buyer–seller messages, without platform fees on local pickups.

ideas.name: Surplus food & neighbour sharing
ideas.pitch: Rescuing unsold food and sharing leftovers locally: Too Good To Go has 50M+ Play installs and is #10 on Apple's US Top Free Food & Drink chart.
ideas.caveats: Too Good To Go sells paid bags from shops; a paid version needs app billing. Free giveaway (Olio-style) works today.
ideas.pasEdge: Neighbours post and claim giveaways in a private community, run locally rather than by a commission-taking marketplace.

ideas.name: Stock watchlist & price alerts
ideas.pitch: Investors follow a watchlist and want a ping at a price level: TradingView is #2 on Apple's US Top Grossing Finance chart with 50M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Quotes need a market-data API key held server-side; real-time data is licensed. A 5-minute check suits end-of-day or swing alerts, not trading.

ideas.name: AI chat assistant (no API key)
ideas.pitch: General AI chat is the biggest new app category: ChatGPT is #4 on Apple's US Top Free chart and has 1B+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Platform AI is text only, 1,024 output tokens, 16,000-char prompt and 200 units per user per day; no image input or generation.
ideas.pasEdge: Runs on the platform's AI with no key for the user and no separate AI subscription.

ideas.name: Send large files by link
ideas.pitch: Sending files too big for email: WeTransfer is #7 on Apple's US Top Grossing Productivity chart; Send Anywhere has 10M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: 50 MB per file on PAS storage, far below WeTransfer's limits. Expiring links need a scheduled clean-up (app workers).
ideas.pasEdge: Send documents and photos by link with sign-in and expiry you control, without ads on the download page.

ideas.name: Room & holiday rental listings
ideas.pitch: Finding a room or a stay: Airbnb is #2 on Apple's US Top Free Travel chart and has 100M+ Play installs; Zillow is #9 in Lifestyle.
ideas.caveats: Listings and enquiries work today; taking booking payments needs app billing, and paying hosts out is not offered.
ideas.pasEdge: A niche or local rentals board with photos and private enquiries, without the big platforms’ service fees.

ideas.name: Job board
ideas.pitch: Job seekers browse and apply on mobile: Indeed is #2 on Apple's US Top Free Business chart and has 100M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: A board needs listings first: a niche or local board is realistic, Indeed-scale is not.
ideas.pasEdge: A focused local or niche board with private applications, so employers don’t pay per listing.

ideas.name: Dating app
ideas.pitch: Dating is one of the top-grossing categories: Tinder is #1 on Apple's US Top Grossing Lifestyle chart and has 500M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Needs photo moderation, blocking and reporting, and a critical mass of local users.
ideas.pasEdge: No paid boosts or swipe limits: everything is in the one PAS subscription.

ideas.name: Video meetings
ideas.pitch: Video calls for work and family: Google Meet has 10B+ Play installs and Zoom is #3 on Apple's US Top Free Business chart.
ideas.caveats: Rooms carry signalling only (32 peers, 4 KB messages). Group calls need a media server, which the PAS docs do not list; 1-on-1 calls fit.

ideas.name: Sports team & club manager
ideas.pitch: Coaches and parents run fixtures, availability and scores: GameChanger is #2 on Apple's US Top Grossing Sports chart.
ideas.caveats: Live game streaming (GameChanger's paid feature) is out of scope.
ideas.pasEdge: TeamSnap's Android app is rated 2.9 on Play; a PAS version has no in-app upsell.

ideas.name: School-to-parent messaging
ideas.pitch: Teachers post updates and message parents: ClassDojo is #5 on Apple's US Top Grossing Education chart with 50M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Children's data needs care; PAS child accounts exist, but school procurement and privacy review are the real barrier.
ideas.pasEdge: Class groups with roles for teachers and parents and push on new messages, without selling data.

ideas.name: Small-business bookkeeping & receipts
ideas.pitch: Owners categorise transactions and keep receipts for tax: QuickBooks is #4 on Apple's US Top Grossing Business chart.
ideas.caveats: Bank feeds need an aggregator (see bank-linked-budgeting); import of bank exports works today.
ideas.pasEdge: Books, receipts and roles for an accountant in one private workspace, without a monthly fee that grows with your business.

ideas.name: Local services marketplace (hire a pro)
ideas.pitch: People hire cleaners, handymen and pet sitters from their phone: Thumbtack is #23 on Apple's US Top Free Lifestyle chart with 478k ratings.
ideas.caveats: Two-sided: needs providers before customers. Payment between customer and pro stays off-platform unless app billing is enabled.
ideas.pasEdge: One PAS subscription, no lead fees inside the app; Taskrabbit's Android app is rated 2.0 on Play.

ideas.name: Appointment booking for salons & studios
ideas.pitch: Clients book haircuts, classes and treatments online: Booksy has 10M+ Play installs and is #11 on Apple's US Top Free Lifestyle chart.
ideas.caveats: Deposits or no-show fees need app billing. Email is capped at 100 a day per app, so reminders at volume should use push.
ideas.pasEdge: A booking page and private calendar for a small business, without per-booking commission.

ideas.name: Flight search & fare alerts
ideas.pitch: Travellers watch routes for a cheaper fare: Skyscanner has 100M+ Play installs; Hopper and KAYAK 10M+ each.
ideas.caveats: Fares come from a paid flight-data API whose key the app owner holds. Booking is handed off to the airline or agent.

ideas.name: Paid membership community
ideas.pitch: Creators run members-only posts and groups: Patreon has 10M+ Play installs; Skool is #23 on Apple's US Top Free Social Networking chart.
ideas.caveats: Recurring membership needs app billing (admin-gated). STRATEGY.md says apps must not gate features behind payments; confirm before building the paid tier.
ideas.pasEdge: Members-only posts and roles in one app, with the membership billed through the platform.

ideas.name: Online shop for a small business
ideas.pitch: Small sellers take orders online: Shopify is #24 on Apple's US Top Free Business chart; Square Point of Sale has 10M+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Payments go through the platform's Stripe account, not the seller's; up to 20 products per app. In-person card readers are out of scope.
ideas.pasEdge: A small catalogue with checkout through the platform, without a monthly store subscription.

ideas.name: Carpooling & shared rides
ideas.pitch: Sharing a car for a regular or long trip: BlaBlaCar has 100M+ Play installs and 2.63M reviews.
ideas.caveats: Cost sharing between riders needs payouts to drivers, which PAS does not offer.
ideas.pasEdge: Riders and drivers coordinate in a private group, without a booking fee on every seat.

ideas.name: Field service jobs for trades
ideas.pitch: Trades businesses schedule crews, send quotes and track jobs: Jobber is #19 on Apple's US Top Grossing Business chart.
ideas.caveats: Team dispatch and client records, unlike the single-user invoice-maker idea. Card payment on an invoice needs app billing.
ideas.pasEdge: A Tailored PAS template the business forks and reshapes, instead of a per-user monthly fee.

ideas.name: Price-drop & back-in-stock alerts
ideas.pitch: Shoppers watch a product and wait for a lower price: ShopSavvy has 10M+ Play installs and Keepa 1M+.
ideas.caveats: Checks run at most every 5 minutes, 3 schedules per app and 5,000 invocations a day. Many retailers block scraping; an official price API is safer.

ideas.name: Team project boards
ideas.pitch: Teams track who does what on shared boards: Trello has 10M+ Play installs; monday.com and Asana 5M+ each.
ideas.pasEdge: Boards private to the team, with roles and no per-seat price to add a teammate.

ideas.name: Sell your own online course
ideas.pitch: Experts sell video courses to their audience: Udemy has 10M+ Play installs; Teachable and Kajabi run creator-owned course apps.
ideas.caveats: Different from content-library: the creator brings the content. 50 MB per file limits long videos. STRATEGY.md says apps must not charge separately; confirm before selling.
ideas.pasEdge: Lessons, files and enrolments in one app, without the marketplace taking a cut of every sale.

ideas.name: Private shared family photo album
ideas.pitch: Parents share baby photos with grandparents privately: FamilyAlbum has 10M+ Play installs and 366K reviews.
ideas.caveats: 50 MB per file and 1,000 files per user per app; video-heavy families will hit the file cap.
ideas.pasEdge: One private album the whole family adds to, without ads or an upload paywall.

ideas.name: Local courier & delivery
ideas.pitch: Sending a parcel across town the same day: Lalamove has 10M+ Play installs and 809K reviews.
ideas.caveats: Drivers share location only while the app is open; background tracking needs a native app.
ideas.pasEdge: Jobs, drivers and live position while the app is open, in a private dispatch board for a small fleet.

ideas.name: Restaurant reservations & waitlist
ideas.pitch: Diners book tables and join waitlists from their phone: OpenTable has 10M+ Play installs and is #32 on Apple's US Top Free Food & Drink chart.
ideas.caveats: A "table ready" push needs the guest to allow notifications; SMS is creator-only.
ideas.pasEdge: A restaurant’s own booking book with a push when the table is ready, and no per-cover fee.

ideas.name: Staff shift scheduling & time clock
ideas.pitch: Shops and cafes publish rosters and staff swap shifts: Connecteam is #45 and Homebase #48 on Apple's US Top Free Business chart.
ideas.caveats: Payroll is out of scope; a clock-in location check works only while the app is open.
ideas.pasEdge: Rosters and shift swaps private to the team, with roles for managers and no per-employee price.

ideas.name: Event ticketing & check-in
ideas.pitch: Organisers sell tickets and scan them at the door: Eventbrite has 10M+ Play installs and 1.8M ratings on Apple.
ideas.caveats: Free RSVPs overlap the event-rsvp idea; this is the paid, scanned-ticket version. Ticket revenue goes through the platform's Stripe account.
ideas.pasEdge: Tickets, check-in and attendee lists in one app, without per-ticket booking fees on top.

ideas.name: Small-business CRM
ideas.pitch: Small teams keep contacts, deals and follow-ups in one place: Salesforce has 5M+ Play installs; HubSpot and Zoho CRM 1M+ each.
ideas.pasEdge: A Tailored PAS template the business forks and reshapes with AI, instead of per-seat CRM pricing.

ideas.name: Social media post scheduler
ideas.pitch: Small businesses queue posts across networks: Hootsuite has 5M+ Play installs and Buffer 1M+.
ideas.caveats: Each network needs an approved developer app and OAuth; posting at a set time needs the scheduled worker (5-minute granularity).

ideas.name: Website uptime monitor
ideas.pitch: Site owners want a ping when their site goes down: UptimeRobot has 100K+ Play installs.
ideas.caveats: Checks every 5 minutes at best (the platform tick), 3 schedules and 5,000 invocations a day per app.
